excerpt: You are ten islands with no oil and no gold, and your debt has fallen as a share of your economy every year since the pandemic.
paras: You are ten islands with no oil and no gold, and your debt has fallen as a share of your economy every year since the pandemic. Your visitors and your diaspora already invest in you. Let the next decade price the sun, the wind and the sea as the assets they are.

Your partners are investing in your islands. The European Investment Bank has approved €143.6 million for green energy and €114 million for sustainable ports, and in December 2025 the European Union added a grant of €33.3 million for the ports. In January 2026 the World Bank announced $13.3 million more for solar and wind power, battery storage and 1,800 new household connections.

The work ahead is plain, and it is worth saying plainly. Sixty-five in every hundred of you lived below $8.30 a day at the last count, in 2015. Forty-six in every hundred of your city dwellers live in slums. Thirty-two in every hundred of you cannot always count on enough good food. Income sets your Coverage today, at 35 out of 100, with shelter and food close behind. Each of them is within your reach.

Now imagine that same resolve turned toward every home in the country. Picture Perfect Cabo Verde: a morning when every family cooks with clean fuel and sits down to a full table; when every tap runs clean and every home has a safe toilet; when every child walks to a school where a teacher is waiting, and reads with ease by the age of ten; when every mother lives within reach of a clinic with the lights on, and every young person finds work that pays. And no Cabo Verdean falls below a decent life, because the nation has decided that none will.
quote: Islands without oil can still be rich in sun, wind and sea. Count them, and let them pay.
